correctness.rationale: From the published Apéry identity w_x=β(x)L_a+x, a gap w_x−L_a is pseudo-Frobenius iff β((x+T_i) mod L_a)≤β(x)+floor((x+T_i)/L_a) for every minimal generator. Isolated vacant digits give necessary independence domination. Lucas identities 2T_i=T_(i+1)+T_(i−2), plus low-index merges, eliminate truncated initial even runs and establish the two upper-path classes; when a odd, maximal Apéry endpoints x=L_a−1,L_a−2 are extra. Maximal independent sets on path obey P_n=P_(n−2)+P_(n−3), giving the formula. Independently enumerated legal words and exact minimal coin DP for a=5..14, with complete pseudo-Frobenius sets agreeing in each case. The finite tests do not prove all a; the carry/normal-form proof supplies that step.
